parent_protocol.rule: Everything the parent fixes -- the question, the five arms, the node words, the twin null, the floors, the prohibitions -- stands unchanged and is not re-litigated, EXCEPT the roster: n is the complete-row count, and the failing and never-started rows are reported by count.

owner_basis: owner decision 320 A (coordinator's proposal of 2026-10-15, PENDING the owner's answer): seal-only the complete rows of the stopped NX-T R1 column, read at the complete-row n, report the failing row and the never-started rows by count, close the cell

abort.error: RailsRunnerError: perception branch 'both-off' sealed no level-2 Solver column
abort.failing_stage: rails.runner._invoke_native_role_episode final assembly (level-2 Solver column fold) after the Solver fan-out
abort.root_cause: the first-visit Solver fan-out (rails/runner.py -> reproduction/ojw/native_supply_variants.run_perception_branch_solver_arms) invokes the five branches in declared order, the delivering arm LAST; the third contact (both-off, enable_thinking false, max_tokens 1024) ended on finish_reason 'length'; FrozenCoreRoleFiniteCompletionError propagated out of the whole fan-out (workflow log 17:59:57-04:00: graph_vertex_ability_error on node solver_0_role, 'metered completion is non-authoritative because finish_reason is length'), the row had made 8 contacts (5 Perception + 3 Solver) not 10, native_episode took its deliver-latest-or-abstain disposition, and the level-2 fold found no Solver record for the first branch without one (both-off)
abort.evidence: campaign log lines 140542-142170 (workflow error and traceback); trace sample-execution-timing record of the failing row (status failed, error_type RailsRunnerError, admission_index 1014 of 1080); 10,298 = 1,029 x 10 + 8 contacts; 0 of 2,058 earlier no-think Solver contacts reached the cap (max completion 66 tokens)
abort.fix: fix: a non-delivering level-2 branch whose Solver contact ends on a finite completion is recorded as an absent column, not fatal (branch sonnet/nxt1-sealonly: run_perception_branch_solver_arms branch_absent seam, receipt keys solver_absent / absent_reason, bundle I7v absent-column check against the recorded wire finish_reason, column renderer = canonical empty answer, readers count absent rows, sign-off condition absent_columns == 0)

seal_only_completion.mechanism: resume_from the stopped attempt by trace sha256 (mode A); every roster row is complete in its trace, so is_seal_only; core.flight.cli seal-only seals the manifest under I7r and runs the one official finalize job; zero model contacts, no server, no slot, no lease
seal_only_completion.why_not_mode_b: a checkpoint (mode B) resume pins the code identity of runtime.py / rails/runner.py / core/row_checkpoint.py; the absent-column fix changes rails/runner.py by design, so the checkpoint would be refused. Its whole-file sha256 is recorded as corroboration only.

resume_replay_proof.gate: scripts/checks/resume_prelaunch_gate_check.py (via scripts/flights/batch/resume_prelaunch_gate.sh) on this cell, re-run by the chain and by the driver's prelaunch on the flight commit
resume_replay_proof.note: Model-free and read-only over a scratch COPY of the stopped attempt's trace (sha256 verified identical to the data root's), assets read through symlinks to the data root: every complete row rendered through the real seal stage and re-checked against I7 / I7n / I7v (including the v5 thinking-policy wire check and the absent-column check, which the replay tool could not see before the 2026-10-15 fix) one row at a time; no row fails and no sample is sealed twice. The driver's prelaunch replay gate re-runs the same check at launch on the flight commit.

recovery_counter: The column's rec1 (a Windows restart) is its one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration, already spent. This is a SEAL-ONLY completion of the rec1 attempt's complete rows -- no row is flown -- and a failure of it closes cell NXT-R1.
